title: Chusky has been upgraded
bullets: Twilio calls now support owner-scoped hangup, DTMF, cold transfer, bounded continuity from an ended call, and optional voicemail delivery after DetectMessageEnd.
Completed phone conversations produce a bounded, structured owner-private outcome with decisions, action items, and open questions across Twilio and provider summaries.
Inbound numbers can route to explicit owners, provider configuration can fall back safely, and voice operations expose reconnecting state plus durable bridge checkpoints.
